mapper.select: select l.id, l.cre_time from blossom_article_log l join blossom_article a on a.id = l.article_id where l.article_id = #{articleId} and a.user_id = #{userId} order by l.cre_time desc
select l.markdown from blossom_article_log l join blossom_article a on a.id = l.article_id where l.id = #{id} and a.user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from blossom_article_log where article_id in #{item}
